title: ServiceResourceCapacityHistory - Data API
description: Represents the history of changes made to tracked fields on a service resource capacity record. This object is available in API version 38.0 and later.

DataType.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
DataType.description: Data type of the field that was changed.

Field.description: The name of the field that was changed.

NewValue.description: The new value of the field that was changed.

OldValue.description: The value of the field before it was changed.

ServiceResourceCapacityId.description: ID of the service resource capacity being tracked. The history is displayed on the detail page for this record.

special_access_rules: Field Service must be enabled in your organization, and field tracking for service resource capacity fields must be configured.
wsdl_segment:
```xml
<simpleType name="ID">
  <restriction base="xsd:string">
    <length value="18"/>
    <pattern value="[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}"/>
  </restriction>
</simpleType>
<complexType name="ServiceResourceCapacityHistory">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="CreatedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:sObject"/>
        <element name="CreatedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="DataType" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="Field" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="IsDeleted" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"/>
        <element name="NewValue" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:anyType"/>
        <element name="OldValue" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:anyType"/>
        <element name="ServiceResourceCapacity" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:ServiceResourceCapacity"/>
        <element name="ServiceResourceCapacityId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
```
